summary.title: Executive Summary — The Week in Numbers

blocks.label: The week in one line
blocks.text: Nifty 50 -0.88% · FPI equity +₹3,843 Cr · USD/INR 96.16 · Brent +0.43% · breadth mixed.
FPIs: a net equity inflow of ₹3,843 Cr across 5 NSDL reporting days (2 of 5 positive); debt +₹885 Cr.
Nifty 50 -0.88% to 23,140.50, Midcap 150 -2.03%, Smallcap 250 -0.70% in the week to 25 Sep.

Of 1,575 coded names in the scan, 670 rose and 898 fell on the week (median -0.51%). Breadth regime: **mixed**, with 45.0% above the 50-DMA and 54.7% above the 200-DMA (-9.4 and -6.9 points over four weeks).
Stage 2 by calculation (all 7 template checks): 382 names, 65 entered and 46 left since 18 Sep. The provider's Stage 2 list (701 names) was not updated this week (the list on file is dated 13 Sep).

SwingEdge sub-sector trackers: 16 of 32 trackers rose. Led by Pharma Mid & Small (+5.75%), Sugar & Ethanol (+5.19%), EMS & Electronics (+4.63%); lagged by Transformers & Reactors (-2.66%), Capital Markets (-2.42%), Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear (-2.29%). The equal-weight market line: +0.48%.

blocks.label: How this report is built
blocks.text: Built automatically by `tools/auto_weekly.py` from data the evening pull already has: the screener.in scan, NSE's index file, NSDL's FPI Monitor, RBI's current rates, Yahoo closes, and SwingEdge's own breadth, Stage 2 and tracker files. No model writes any of it: each sentence is a template filled with the week's numbers. Not collected: DII daily flows and derivatives positioning (no keyless source). Facts only; nothing here rates a stock.
